name: SD: A print shop's paper and toner (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A print shop's mono and colour pages queued, printed pages awaiting collection, and the paper and toner on hand, counted every hour. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-print-shop/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests co-flows that share and combine: every page printed, mono or colour, uses a sheet of paper and some toner (colour ten times as much), so a colour rush runs the toner low and slows both printers, and a late paper delivery stops them both.
